narrative.overview: A calm Academic Modernist workspace with pale sage canvas, paper-white working surfaces, Oxford-forest controls, warm-grey structure, editorial Domine headings, and crisp Hanken Grotesk data. It is designed for complete operational visibility across learner, teaching, and admin work.
keyCharacteristics: Horizontally reachable dense and matrix tables
Restrained state motion with a global reduced-motion contract

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Use forest and clay for action, selection, progress, and status; pair color with text or semantics.

rules.name: The Density Rule
rules.body: Preserve every data field and table column; narrow screens scroll instead of hiding evidence.

rules.name: The Focus Contract
rules.body: All interactive controls show visible focus; mobile navigation traps focus while open and restores it on dismiss.

rules.name: The Application Contract
rules.body: Visual work preserves routes, permissions, Jinja conditions, form semantics, data, factual copy, CSRF handling, and HTMX behavior.

dos: Do retain the Dotmac logo and name in the header.
Do keep tables horizontally scrollable and matrix headers/first columns sticky.
Do use Domine for hierarchy and Hanken Grotesk for operations.
Do honor reduced motion and 40px minimum controls.
donts: Don't hide columns or convert operational tables into incomplete mobile cards.
Don't use pills for general controls or containers.
Don't add decorative gradients, glass, nostalgia, or oversized radii.
Don't change routes, data, permissions, copy, or HTMX behavior while styling.
